title: Illumina DNA Prep Tagmentation Library Preparation for MiSeq Sequencer
author: Julie Haendiges
materials: Upon completion of the incubation, remove the plate from the thermocycler. Proceed to the Post Tagmentation Cleanup step.
Invert the EPM to mix, then briefly centrifuge.
Gently pipet at least 10 times to mix.
Appendix 1 DNA Prep Library Workbook DNAPrepWorkbook_2024.xlsx
Resources: Illumina DNA Prep Reference Guide

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Plate
steps.instruction: Bring BLT (from refrigerator) and TB1 (from freezer) to room temperature. Ensure BLT is stored upright to keep beads submerged.

substeps.instruction: Label a 96-well PCR plate with the Run ID.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Add molecular-grade water to each sample well (per Column G of workbook).

substeps.instruction: Add gDNA to the water (per volume in Column F).
Mix well by gently pipetting 5-10 times.

steps.title: Prepare Tagmentation Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Tagmentation Master Mix, scaling up for the number of reactions plus 3-4 for dead space/error.

substeps.instruction: Vortex BLT vigorously for 10 seconds; visually check for complete resuspension and repeat if necessary. Do not spin down the BLT tube.
Vortex TB1 and spin down the tube.
Combine 10 µL of TB1 with 10 µL of BLT Reagent per sample.
Vortex the Tagmentation Master Mix thoroughly to ensure beads are evenly resuspended.

steps.title: Perform Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Distribute the master mix and incubate the samples.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of Tagmentation Master Mix to each sample well using fresh tips.
Pipette up and down 10 times to mix the 50 μl reaction and resuspend beads.
Apply an adhesive PCR plate seal.
Incubate in a thermocycler at 55 °C for 00:15:00, followed by a 10 °C hold (lid heated at 100 °C).

steps.title: Stop Tagmentation and Resuspend
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction using TSB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Check TSB for precipitate; if present, warm at 37 °C for up to 10 minutes and vortex. Ensure TSB is at room temperature.
Remove the plate seal.
Add 10 µL of TSB to each sample.
Gently pipette up and down 10 times to mix and fully resuspend beads in the 50 μl reaction.
Apply an adhesive PCR plate seal.
Incubate in a thermocycler at 37 °C for 00:15:00, followed by a 10 °C hold (lid heated at 100 °C).

steps.title: Bead Cleanup and Washing
steps.instruction: Perform a series of bead-based washes to clean the tagged DNA.

substeps.instruction: While samples incubate, thaw EPM on ice and indices at room temperature.
Remove plate from thermocycler, quick spin, and remove seal.
Place plate on a magnet for 00:03:00 or until solution is clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant using a multichannel pipette.
Remove plate from magnet and add 100 µL of TWB directly to the pellet; gently pipette to mix (avoid foam).
Place on magnet for 00:03:00 or until clear; remove and discard supernatant.
Remove plate from magnet and add 100 µL of TWB directly to the pellet; gently pipette to mix.
Place on magnet for 00:03:00 or until clear; remove and discard supernatant.
Remove plate from magnet and add 100 µL of TWB directly to the pellet; gently pipette to mix.
Place plate with TWB on the magnet and incubate for at least 3 minutes until ready for PCR master mix.

steps.title: Amplify Tagmented DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR master mix and amplify the library.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR master mix (scale for reactions plus 3-4 for dead space): Combine 20 µL of EPM with 20 µL of molecular grade water per sample.
Vortex and spin down the PCR master mix.
While on the magnet, remove the third TWB wash and any excess liquid using a small volume pipette.
Remove plate from magnet and immediately add 40 µL of PCR master mix to each well; gently pipette to mix.
Add 10 µL of the appropriate index primer pair to each well.
Gently mix a minimum of 10 times.
Apply an adhesive PCR plate seal.
Centrifuge plate at 280 x g for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform double-sided size selection using IPB and RSB beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh 80% ethanol. Bring RSB to room temperature and vortex. Vortex and invert IPB to resuspend beads.
Pipette 40 µL of molecular grade water into wells of a new 96-well plate (or new wells on the sample plate).
If plate was stored at 4 °C, centrifuge at 280 x g for 1 minute and remove seal.
Place sample plate on magnet for 00:05:00.
Transfer 45 µL of supernatant to the wells containing 40 μl of water.
Remove sample plate from magnet. Vortex IPB and add 45 µL to each well containing PCR product and water.
Pipette to mix at least 10 times. Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Place plate on magnet for 00:05:00 or until clear (vortex IPB during this time).
Transfer 125 µL of supernatant to a new set of wells.
Remove plate from magnet and add 15 µL of IPB to the supernatant. Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Place on magnet for 00:05:00 or until clear; remove and discard supernatant.
Perform two washes: While on magnet, add 180 µL of 80% ethanol (do not add directly to beads or mix), incubate for 00:00:30, then discard ethanol.
Remove any excess liquid with a small volume pipette.
Air dry beads for 3 to 5 minutes (do not over-dry; resuspend immediately if pellet cracks).
Remove plate from magnet, add 32 µL of RSB, and pipette thoroughly to mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:02:00.
Place plate on magnet for 00:02:00.

steps.title: Final Library Recovery and Quantification
steps.instruction: Recover the final library and determine concentration.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 25 µL of the supernatant to a new 96-well plate (labeled with date and initials).
Quantify each sample using the Qubit dsDNA High Sensitivity kit.
Enter Qubit values into Column K of the DNA Prep Library worksheet.

steps.title: Library Dilution and Pooling
steps.instruction: Dilute libraries to the required concentration based on sequencing chemistry.

substeps.instruction: Dilute to 2nm for v2 chemistry or 4nm for v3 chemistry. Use Resuspension Buffer, Molecular Grade Water, or 10mm Tris-HCl with 0.1% Tween20 as diluents.
Dilute to a 15 μl volume (or as specified in Column N) according to worksheet values (Column O and P).
Pool 5 µL of each diluted library into the specified well (use 2.5 µL if sequencing Campylobacter) and pipette to mix.

steps.title: Denaturation and Loading Preparation
steps.instruction: Denature the dsDNA and prepare for MiSeq loading.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh 0.2N NaOH (can be diluted from 1N NaOH stored in freezer).
Transfer 5 µL of diluted library to a new Eppendorf LoBind tube.
Add 5 µL of 0.2N NaOH and pipette to mix. Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Immediately add 990 µL of HT1 and pipette to mix (resulting in 10 pM for 2 nm start or 20 pM for 4 nm start).
Dilute to final desired loading concentration and mix by repeated inversion. (Optional: spike in denatured PhiX control).
Heat denatured DNA library to 96 °C for 00:02:00 in a heat block.
Immediately cool in an ice-water bath for at least 00:05:00.
Load 600 µL of the denatured library into the thawed cartridge.
